departments.create.description: Create a department anywhere in the tree (code unique within the tenant; parent must exist; leader must be a user of this tenant). Tenant side only; requires organization.departments.create.
departments.get.description: Get a department with its ancestors, leader user name, child count and member count. Requires organization.departments.read.
departments.tree.description: The whole department tree of the current tenant with direct member counts. Requires organization.departments.read.
departments.update.description: Update a department's name, leader, order, description and status (the parent is changed with departments.move). Requires organization.departments.update.
departments.move.description: Move a department under another parent or to the top level; moving under itself or a descendant is rejected. Requires organization.departments.update.
departments.delete.description: Delete departments in batch; departments that still have children or members are rejected item by item. Requires organization.departments.delete.
positions.create.description: Create a position (code unique within the tenant). Requires organization.positions.create.
positions.list.description: List positions with paging, keyword, filters and sorting. Requires organization.positions.read.
positions.update.description: Update a position's name, order, description and status. Requires organization.positions.update.
positions.delete.description: Delete positions in batch; positions still referenced by memberships are rejected item by item. Requires organization.positions.delete.
memberships.create.description: Add a user of this tenant to a department, optionally with a position; the first membership of a user becomes the primary one. Requires organization.memberships.create.
memberships.list.description: List memberships filtered by department, user, position or primary flag, with user, department and position names. Requires organization.memberships.read.
memberships.update.description: Update a membership's position, primary flag, employee number, grade, hire date and order. Requires organization.memberships.update.
memberships.delete.description: Remove users from departments in batch; when a primary membership is removed the next one becomes primary. Requires organization.memberships.delete.
organization.department.in_use: Department '{id}' still has child departments or members.
organization.department.cyclic_move: Department '{id}' cannot be moved under itself or one of its descendants.
organization.position.in_use: Position '{id}' is still referenced by memberships.
organization.membership.exists: User '{userId}' is already a member of department '{departmentId}'.
organization.membership.user_not_in_tena: User '{userId}' does not belong to this tenant.
organization.tenant_only: Organization is managed from the tenant side only.
